transport.authentication: HttpOnly host-only SameSite=Strict session cookie; Secure on HTTPS
transport.csrf: validate Host and Origin on mutations
transport.http_scope: private LAN only; credentials and content are unencrypted
transport.https: optional configured PEM certificate and private key

semantics.queue: one global durable ordered queue; duplicate tracks retain distinct entries
semantics.output: one selected output shared by UPnP, AirPlay, Google Cast, and local audio; ordinary output selection and AirPlay pairing require stopped state; guarded local fallback may replace a nonempty absent/offline selected output only with an online browser-protocol output while stopped or unavailable and without active commands, requires the expected renderer and player revision to match, preserves the queue, current entry, saved position, duration and playback modes, clears obsolete transport/error state, and requires explicit Play to resume the saved position without autoplay
semantics.pairing: AirPlay setup uses an empty PairingRequest to begin, then a second request with the prompted PIN and/or password; credentials are write-only and never persisted by clients
semantics.autoplay: never on enqueue, startup, reconnect, scan, or output selection
semantics.likes: shared Server-persisted track likes survive rescans and restarts; liked-only browsing is paginated; append_liked_shuffled snapshots every available liked track in randomized order and atomically appends that snapshot to the queue end without creating a playlist or starting playback
semantics.play_counts: one shared Server-wide durable count per catalog track; increments at most once per play after confirmed actual listening reaches the lesser of 30 seconds and half the duration (the half-duration rule applies to tracks shorter than 60 seconds); paused time and seek-skipped time do not qualify; pause and resume cannot duplicate a count; collection begins with this feature without historical backfill; standalone Android Saved Music is excluded; counts survive rescans and restarts; played=true includes only positive counts and sort=most_played orders every filtered match by descending play_count then title and id before pagination
semantics.browser_output: ephemeral local-audio registrations share the Server queue and may execute through browser HTML audio or the native Android audio service; owner-token and source-IP bound command acknowledgments and media events drive observed state; closing, reloading, backgrounding or losing the lease preserves queue entries without autoplay; no UPnP endpoint or hardware sink picker is created
semantics.browser_transport: the browser protocol identifies the authenticated local-audio transport, not a specific playback engine; same-origin HTTP JSON control plus session-authenticated HTTP GET/Range media is shared by browser and native Android execution; registration owner tokens are sent only in X-Jastreamer-Browser-Token and never exposed through the Web UI or native bridge; transport acknowledgments remain available while restart drains user mutations
semantics.browser_report_idempotency: after owner-token, source-IP and cancellation fences, an exact retry of only the last accepted terminal command report returns the same successful acknowledgment without notifying, executing again, replacing newer observed evidence or resolving a newer pending command; sequence, result, error_code and the complete optional observation must be identical; changed, superseded, stale and canceled reports remain rejected; acknowledgments are registration-scoped and memory-only
semantics.browser_names: client-derived defaults with per-client aliases stored by validated Server UUID and canonical origin; only the owning client marks its exact registration as local; owner-authenticated renaming preserves registration identity, transport commands, queue and playback
semantics.observation_failure: mark status uncertain without revoking an existing stream; status_warning appears after three consecutive failed observations, retains its id within the failure streak, and clears on the next successful observation; error remains for immediate command or confirmed playback failures; confirmed disconnection requires explicit resume
semantics.natural_end: correlated completion, or an owned terminal position repeatedly held for two seconds; the latter requires acknowledged Stop before advancement
semantics.playback_modes: shuffle traverses the immutable displayed shared queue by unique queue-entry identity without repetition; previous follows traversal history and explicit play-next entries retain precedence; repeat one applies only to confirmed natural completion while repeat all begins a fresh completed traversal; modes persist across restart without autoplay and Server output changes preserve them
semantics.media_failure: an explicit media_failed report or an unavailable/missing queued library entry is a terminal item/engine failure, not natural completion; the Server retains the failed queue entry as error and advances once through the active sequential or shuffle traversal while playback is intended, without repeat wrapping or a blocking notice when a successor exists; traversal end retains a visible error and all-error playback terminates; stopped/paused/recovered sessions and generic transport/auth/permission/lease/unknown failures never auto-skip; failed entries remain available for explicit retry
semantics.history: authenticated read-only shared history of accepted renderer errors and failed or unverified library checks; newest 5000 records persist across restarts; structured safe details and root-relative paths only; imported historical renderer IDs may lack a display name; JSON lists retain a 100-row page maximum while CSV export returns every retained matching record newest-first from one snapshot with UTF-8 BOM and spreadsheet-formula-neutralized cells
semantics.library_verification: scans default to incremental: enumerate files and reuse stored metadata and terminal verification outcomes for unchanged root/path/size/modified-time identities; new or changed files and unfinished checks are decoded; explicit full mode rereads metadata and verifies all files; retained failed and unverified outcomes remain visible without duplicate history; results survive restarts; one file at a time, paused during playback or scanning; FLAC sample count and nonzero STREAMINFO MD5 are checked; original files and playback state are never changed; unavailable engines and inconclusive checks are not successful verification
semantics.library_recursive_browse: recursive=true is accepted only for tracks with a nonempty root_id; it includes available tracks in the exact root-relative path and every slash-delimited descendant before existing search, liked, played, artist and genre filters, deterministic sorting and pagination; an empty path selects the entire root; omitted or false retains direct-child browsing; percent and underscore are literal path characters, and prefix siblings and other roots are excluded
semantics.offline_imports: platform-neutral v1 authenticated import protocol for native Android and later native iOS clients; jobs remain bound to the requesting account while preparing or serving artifacts, but verified client-committed files are independently device-owned and are never revoked, synchronized, or deleted by this Server
semantics.download_snapshot: track and album jobs capture the selected catalog entries; folder jobs recursively capture available tracks under one validated root-relative folder in deterministic path order without including prefix siblings or other roots; playlist jobs atomically capture name, order and duplicate entries at request time; every collection is bounded to 10000 tracks; later catalog, folder or playlist mutations do not alter a manifest and snapshots never mutate the Server queue
semantics.download_artifacts: original quality is an immutable byte-for-byte copy of the descriptor-safe library source; a known failed full-file verification for the same indexed source version is rejected; aac_256 is immutable AAC-LC at 256 kbps in seekable M4A and is advertised only when the configured FFmpeg proves the native AAC encoder and iPod/M4A muxer; media.transcode controls receiver routing and does not gate explicit import conversion
semantics.download_lifecycle: preparation has atomic per-owner and global admission, a persisted overall deadline, bounded workers, and cancellation; interrupted or expired pending work fails deterministically while already verified ready tracks remain available as a partial job; terminal artifacts expire and are released under a bounded Server-side retention budget without affecting files a native client already committed
semantics.download_files: owner-authenticated GET and HEAD return only ready immutable artifacts with actual Content-Length and SHA-256 ETag; byte ranges and If-Range use standard HTTP semantics; redirects and play-lease media URLs are not part of this protocol; requests never mutate the shared player, output or queue
semantics.native_download_bridge: the top-level current document may request only its exact canonical Server origin and authenticated principal jobs; configure_network requires job_id, shows native explicit network consent/settings, and returns {}; open_downloads opens the native Downloads screen and returns {}; neither action grants cross-origin or cross-principal job access
semantics.events: invalidation only; clients refetch on open, gap, resync, and reconnect
semantics.restart: explicit authenticated request for the saved config revision; confirms playback stop before teardown, preserves persistent state without autoplay, and reinitializes services in-process; 202 is acceptance, not completion
semantics.restart_confirmation: same-origin clients refetch config until runtime_id changes and restart_required clears; restart_error reports recovery after failed startup; changed origins require explicit navigation without cross-origin authenticated API requests
semantics.restart_storage: data_dir changes require separate data migration and manual restart; the Control restart operation does not migrate or initialize replacement storage

response.reconnect_url: absolute HTTP(S) client URL for the target listener

request.mode: incremental|full; optional; omitted body or mode defaults to incremental

routes.response: UTF-8 BOM text/csv attachment; all retained matching rows; columns event_id,timestamp,type,outcome,track_title,track_id,folder,relative_path,stage,code,message,renderer_name,renderer_id,renderer_protocol,position_ms,play_id,command_id,details_json

request.name: non-empty trimmed string; at most 80 UTF-8 bytes

request.constraint: at least one field is required; omitted fields retain their current value

request.expected_renderer_id: nonempty currently selected absent/offline output id

errors.409: guard changed, current output recovered, destination unavailable/ineligible, player state disallowed, or command active

routes.response: immutable audio bytes; 409 until that track is ready
same status and headers as GET without a body

ConfigDocument.restart_required: boolean; saved config differs from active runtime after accounting for live-applied library roots
ConfigDocument.runtime_id: string; changes on each runtime reinitialization
ConfigDocument.restart_error: string?; failure that caused recovery to previous runtime

Root.name: string
Root.path: absolute path in Server configuration only

FilesystemPage.path: native absolute server directory path or empty for roots

NetworkAddress.address: IP address string without a prefix
NetworkAddress.upnp_usable: boolean; true only for an active multicast non-loopback interface with a DLNA-compatible private or IPv4 link-local prefix

Track.title: string
Track.play_count: nonnegative integer; shared Server-wide completed play count, zero when absent

VerificationStatus.reason: string; playback or scan when paused

Device.name: string
Device.model: string; browser protocol registrations use Local audio for either HTML or native Android execution

BrowserRegistration.owner_token: opaque secret; keep only in the owning local-audio transport memory and never expose through the Web UI or native bridge
BrowserRegistration.lease_duration_ms: integer; measure deadline from request start using a monotonic clock

BrowserReport.error_code: media_unsupported|media_error|media_failed|action_failed?; media_failed only for failed set_uri/play commands or unsolicited observation.event=error; no error code on successful or non-error observations
BrowserReport.observation: BrowserObservation?; a failed command may carry only a correlated error observation

BrowserObservation.state: playing|paused; required for seeked and timeupdate

StatusWarning.id: integer; stable within one consecutive observation-failure streak

DownloadCapabilities.qualities: original|aac_256[]; original is always present, aac_256 only when usable

DownloadRequest.id: catalog source id; required only for track, album, or playlist
DownloadRequest.root_id: catalog root id; required only for folder
DownloadRequest.path: validated root-relative folder path; required for folder and empty for the selected root

DownloadTrack.index: zero-based snapshot position; duplicates retain separate positions
DownloadTrack.track_id: temporary source identity used only while importing
DownloadTrack.title: copied title
DownloadTrack.mime: actual MIME when ready, otherwise empty
DownloadTrack.codec: actual codec when ready, otherwise empty
DownloadTrack.byte_size: actual verified byte count when ready, otherwise zero
DownloadTrack.sha256: 64 lowercase hex when ready, otherwise empty
DownloadTrack.media_path: owner-authenticated same-origin path when ready, otherwise empty
DownloadTrack.artwork_path: authenticated existing artwork path or empty

DownloadManifest.title: copied collection display title
DownloadManifest.expires_at: RFC3339 overall preparation deadline while status is preparing; artifact expiry after terminal transition

ServerConfig.server_name: optional display name; empty uses hostname

https.certificate_file: absolute path or empty when disabled
https.private_key_file: absolute path or empty when disabled

airplay.helper_path: absolute path or empty when disabled

cast.enabled: boolean; optional on input and defaults to false
